title: read through a stale pointer, with no allocation between the free and the use
object: a, 24 bytes, freed and then read
control: the read happens before the free

asan.why: As case 8, and the read returns the object's own old bytes under an arena, so the program cannot notice either.

hwasan.why: As case 8. HWASan has no public custom-allocator interface, so the annotated columns are UNSUPPORTED, not MISSED (C3.4).

ubsan.why: -fsanitize=bounds needs a statically known array bound; a pointer out of an allocator has none. The row is kept so the report can say UBSan is not a heap tool rather than leaving it out.

lowfat.why: LowFat checks bounds only; it has no notion of a lifetime.

status: written, smoke-run on malloc and arena; server run pending (A5)
